fichas.title: Brick and Block Masonry Bonds
fichas.summary: Explains how regular masonry courses and bonds transfer loads and help prevent cracking. It describes stretcher, header and soldier courses; the importance of overlapping vertical joints; traditional and modern bond patterns; and small holes coursed into masonry for light or ventilation.
uses: Reducing cracking and the proportion of joints
